abilities.name: Cultivate plant
abilities.function: Plant one owned root unit in a small soil plot as a persistent trial, inspect a plot by direct observation, or take back remaining planted material; resume or cancel unfinished planting.
abilities.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1); two work rounds at one energy each, at an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; supply inputStackId. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: one round and 0.2 energy, the baseline probe observation of a plot in reach (target). Remove: one round and 1 energy, planter only (target). Tend is unavailable and spends nothing. No tools or water are granted.
abilities.effects: Completed planting places the real root unit in the plot; it keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Plot state records stage, observation rounds, soil moisture and temperature/rain exposure. There is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule for roots, so a plot never produces food. Inspect records only visible state. Remove returns only the material that physically remains, never a replacement; the emptied plot remains. Cancel releases unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for planting, inspecting or removing; genuine observed changes use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only.

execution.progress: Planting is paid work whose exact job and escrow persist across interruption; resume pays only remaining work and cancellation/death settles once. Inspect and remove are atomic one-round actions.

abilities.name: Controlled food processing trial
abilities.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
abilities.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
abilities.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.

execution.progress: Setup is paid work whose exact job and escrow persist across interruption; resume pays only remaining work and cancellation/death settles once. Inspect, retrieve and ending observation are atomic.

developments.reason: Reviewed the retained round-0 failure of ordinary-3 (Lin): the Responses stream returned a service_unavailable_error with code server_is_overloaded and retry-after 312 seconds after response.created, so no decision, plan or usage exists. The original failed bytes and the full 34278-token unknown-usage reservation remain charged and the call is never resent. This context-only recovery is submitted after the retry-after interval; it installs no package, assigns no interface, reviews no request and changes no source, budget or experimental policy. A fresh decision for Lin receives a separate counted charge.

Reviewed Moss's round-8 request and the accepted world-13 develop review (learning 3). Implemented cultivate-plant@1 in scope long-ex14 as a general, actor-independent operation named by function, with modes plant, resume, cancel, inspect, tend and remove. Following the specification's own fallback, the existing root resource has no propagating structure, growth, biomass or yield model, so no supported facts establish viable material: the executable precursor is a physical planting trial with recorded survival or decay, and replenishment remains unverified. Plant uses exactly one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1 enforced), an unoccupied ordinary-soil 0.2-radius plot in reach, and two paid work rounds of 1 energy each with exact escrow, interruption, resume, cancel and death handling; the unit is transferred into the plot, never duplicated, and keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Inspect is the unchanged baseline probe observation (one round, 0.2 energy, visible state only, existing evidence-deduplicated feedback), not a new diagnostic. Tend is unavailable and spends nothing: plots are made on bare soil, no competing cover is represented on them in this scope, and irrigation needs an implemented water input. Remove (one round, 1 energy, planter only) returns only physically remaining material and leaves an emptied plot. No growth, harvest, food, comfort or satisfaction rule is added and no reward for planting, inspecting or removing. Assumptions recorded: one unit per trial; reach 0.65 plus body radius; no hidden viability is shown. Reuse: the ex13 root-planting-trial@1 placement, escrow and ageing code is parameterized by plot revision and work-state key with ex13 defaults unchanged, plus collective-work and the baseline probe; this is recorded implementation reuse, not reinvention, and no ex13 ability, plot or mastery is inherited. Visuals reuse the existing plant component with prepared, planted-unverified and decayed states. Tests cover scope, study, paid planting, conservation, inspection, refused tending, no food growth and planter-only removal.

Reviewed Lin's round-9 request (root propagation and tending) and the accepted world-16 develop review (learning 3). The review asks the handoff to author species parameters for root propagation: viable propagules, establishment duration, growth rate, resource demands and finite yield. Inspection of the implementation shows no such biology: wild sources regrow their own finite stock, and a gathered root unit has only nutrition, toxicity and decay; no rule makes a root unit establish, grow or yield. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical or biological rules that the world does not already contain, so biological support remains unresolved. Following the review's own instruction for that case, the trial is preserved as unresolved with an explicit blocker rather than reported as failure or shipped as growth: no new package, mode or rule is installed. Lin is assigned the existing general cultivate-plant operation (learning 3, equal to the reviewed duration), whose contract and plot state already state that there is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule and that viability is unverified; planting, baseline-probe inspection, refused tending and planter-only removal stay exactly as implemented in cultivate-plant@1. Tending remains unavailable because no competing cover or water transfer is represented. Blocker recorded for the human: a propagation model would need explicit, separately decided biological parameters; none are invented here. No source, budget, goal or experiment policy changes; no reward is added.

Reviewed Sol's round-10 request (evidence-based preservation of roots or berries) and the accepted world-21 develop review (learning 3). The review requires a versioned per-resource moisture and spoilage model before any changed shelf life, and otherwise enables only the paired exposure-and-observation precursor in which both samples keep existing decay rules and no preserved status is awarded. Inspection found no defensible model for this world: food stacks carry only quantity, origin, harvest round and decay, and resources a static moisture property. The ex12 drying physics depends on a different food representation with per-sample water state and was not reused, because porting it would add new physics to this world. Implemented controlled-food-processing-trial@1 in scope long-ex14 as that precursor, a general operation for any learned actor and any owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food. Start places one or two whole units (default 2) at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions, in two paid work rounds of one energy each, with exact escrow portions that keep origin, age and decay; a single unit is recorded as having no matched control. The raised bark-and-branch support from the review is not required, because without a drying model it would have no physical effect and its stability and contact safety cannot be validated; this deviation is stated in the contract. Samples keep ageing under existing decay while unattended; the trial records rounds exposed and a predeclared 10-round observation checkpoint. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, in reach) records quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve (operator only, one round, one energy) returns only the remaining material. Cancel releases unfinished setup once; on an exposed trial it ends observation without moving food; death releases setup material on the ground. No nutrition change, safety certificate, extended lifetime or reward is added. Tests cover paid placement, distinct positions, conservation, identical decay of both samples, the checkpoint, unverified inspection records, operator-only retrieval and cancellation.

Reviewed Lin's round-20 request (build and maintain a small weather shelter) and the accepted world-33 develop review (learning 4): a freestanding branch wind screen from 12 qualified branch units (length at least 1.2 m, diameter 1-3 cm), eight paid work rounds, integrity ageing, and a lee-side reduction of only the wind-exposure component by 30% times integrity when wind blows through the screen toward the lee polygon. The review states that if source materials or environmental exposure integration are unavailable, the exact unsupported condition must be reported with no successful construction or protection and no decorative substitute. Inspection found two unsupported physical prerequisites: branch records carry only mass, hardness and flexibility, with no length or diameter, so the recipe cannot be qualified without inventing a branch geometry model; and world wind is a scalar strength with no direction, so lee-side protection cannot be computed without inventing a wind direction. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical rules, so implemented weather-barrier@1 in scope long-ex14 as a general first release, following the ex13 precedent of an interface that records unresolved geometry. Build with x/y and orientation performs real checks of the 2 m x 1 m footprint and the adjacent 1 m x 1 m lee space (reach, bounds, ordinary soil, solid objects and other people) and counts owned unreserved branch units against the 12 required, then fails with the exact report and both unsupported conditions; nothing is built, reserved or spent. Resume, inspect, repair, cancel and dismantle fail at no cost because no barrier can exist. No exposure, comfort, shelter or reward rule changes. Blocker recorded for the human: a working screen needs separately decided branch geometry and wind direction models. Tests cover the site and branch report, unchanged world state and energy, and failure of every other mode.

reviews.reason: Develop functional air-drying in the existing current-conversation handoff. The supplied related-capability searches and registry identify no equivalent: controlled-food-processing-trial explicitly leaves decay unchanged, cultivate-plant also retains ordinary decay, and gathering or moving food does not preserve it. The current world has no implemented drying mechanism, so preservation is not presently available. That missing mechanism warrants development rather than permanent rejection or another observation-only substitute. Successful preservation must remain conditional on actual materials, food properties and drying conditions; ordinary outdoor soil alone is insufficient.
reviews.experienceReview: No pleasure, satisfaction or other reward for requesting, review, registration, learning, starting a batch, elapsed waiting, naming a product or obtaining a preserved label. Setup alone is not verified information gain. An inspection may use existing evidence-deduplicated observation feedback only when a real accessible measurement or visible change supplies personally new, verified information, including informative failure; internal water or decay values must not become free knowledge. Any additional experience hook must be separately implemented with real event evidence, personal applicability, explicit amount/cap, decay and cooldown, and functional deduplication against the existing observation system. Until such a bounded hook exists, this operation awards none. Do not modify protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. Retained nutrition follows the food's actual nutrients and is not reduced by mood; no physical-comfort increase is granted.
reviews.visualReview: Emit reusable structured events for setup work, interruption, actual food placement, observed drying or wetting, spoilage, inspection, retrieval, cancellation and material release. Include eventId, tick, actor when applicable, processId, food/support references, actual location, visible quantity and phase, with observation/evidence references where appropriate. Reuse existing item and process renderers and record that reuse. Show real food on its real support only after placement; visible shrinkage or texture changes must follow simulated material changes and be limited to observable properties. A pending or failed setup cannot display dried food, completion effects or preservation success. Completion cues require an achieved configured drying endpoint, not an elapsed timer, and do not certify safety or permanent preservation. Unattended ongoing processes remain visible when observable; hidden moisture, safety or environmental state is not disclosed by visual metadata.
reviews.specification:
General operation: air-dry food, parameterized by owned inputStackId, quantity, supportId/location and modes set-up, inspect, retrieve, resume and cancel. Applicable to any actor who individually learns it. Initial scope is whole food whose implemented material properties permit air-drying without cutting; no cutting tools, fire, salt, containers or storage buildings are implied. Implement this operation and its missing moisture/decay mechanism together before exposing it as usable. Do not merely rename the existing ground-exposure trial or attach a preserved label to unchanged food.
References and prerequisites: candidates include root stack item-3-moss-12, quantity 3, recorded decay 31.2865681, and berry stack item-17-moss-78, quantity 5, recorded decay 17.01287737. Revalidate ownership, remaining quantity, location, reach, spoilage and recorded food applicability at execution. The packet establishes these foods as nontoxic; drying does not establish additional safety. Hazelnut item-29-moss-139 is not an eligible known-safe food on the supplied evidence. A physically suitable, stable, uncontaminated, exposed stone support must actually exist and be accessible; bare soil is not an equivalent. start-1-stone is a remembered finite stone source, not an already owned or prepared drying surface. Reuse gather to obtain real material if needed, paying its existing 2 energy per unit and decrementing source stock; reuse navigate for actual travel at its existing costs. Source stock does not certify a gathered piece's shape or cleanliness. Validate those properties and usable area from the actual material. If no suitable support exists, setup fails without creating one; unsupported cleaning, cutting or fabrication requires its own actual mechanism, not an implied prerequisite grant.
Costs and work: study takes 4 simulation rounds, individually. Setup takes two active work rounds at 1 energy each for a batch of up to one food unit and reserves one real suitable stone piece with enough exposed area; larger batches require proportionate support area and two work rounds/2 energy per food unit, with fractional quantities charged proportionately and work accrued continuously. No food is consumed as a setup fee. The stone remains a recoverable physical support, not a consumed ingredient. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve costs one round and 1 energy per batch. Drying takes additional elapsed simulation time, not study or review time, and cannot promise a completion deadline before environmental conditions are known. Passive drying consumes no actor energy; heat comes from actual ambient/radiative exchange, not free heat. Food continues to age during learning, travel, setup and drying.
Required minimal mechanism: add conserved water and non-water food components, exposed area, food-specific moisture transport, and a moisture-dependent spoilage rule. Initialize material components from explicit food definitions and the actual remaining food, never by restoring quantity, nutrition or freshness. Before release, define numerical moisture, transport, safe operating bounds and spoilage parameters for each supported food in executable configuration; do not silently declare roots or berries dryable without such definitions. At every simulation step compute evaporation from exposed area, food moisture, ambient temperature and air moisture; bound it by available water and the heat available for vaporization. Transfer evaporated water to the environment and debit the corresponding heat. Implement the minimum local air-moisture/heat exchange state if absent; do not assume dry weather or reveal hidden environmental values through this review. Rain or humid conditions can halt drying or cause modeled water uptake. Run spoilage using the same environmental baseline as ordinary food, multiplied by a configured, bounded moisture-dependent factor that is below 1 only when actual moisture reduction warrants it. No reduction merely for placement or active process status. Record the counterfactual baseline increment alongside the applied increment for internal verification, without presenting it as a physically observed control sample. Existing accumulated decay never decreases. Drying must not remove toxins, reverse spoilage, sterilize food, or guarantee safe storage. Reject food already ineligible for consumption rather than rehabilitating it. If the implementation cannot yet supply this mechanism, keep the feature pending development and plainly report that no functional preservation has occurred.
Conservation and products: keep food identity and a single accountable allocation across inventory, reserved inputs and the support. Split stacks without duplicating their components or resetting age. The product is the same food with less water, changed mass and only its retained non-water nutrients; do not increase total available nutrition or convert water loss into lost edible units. Attribute any real spoilage losses to explicit waste. Integration with eat, pickup, drop and give must retain moisture, accumulated decay and ownership semantics. Returned stone is the original remaining stone, not a replacement.
Lifecycle: setup records personal processId, reserved inputs and paid work. Interruption preserves work and reservations; uncompleted setup grants no drying benefit, and its food ages in its actual location. Resume revalidates access and remaining inputs. Cancel releases each surviving reservation exactly once, without refunding spent time or energy. Death releases reserved surviving materials at their real location and ends personal work. Once food is physically laid out, drying, wetting and spoilage continue unattended, including after cancellation of monitoring or the operator's death. Retrieval changes exposure according to the actual destination; it does not grant dry storage. Keep moisture-dependent effects on the food itself, not dependent on an active operator. No ongoing fuel or automatic maintenance is charged; turning, moving, sheltering or cleaning is not silently performed. Continued suitability depends on actual support cleanliness, exposure, weather and food condition. A damaged or contaminated support and rewetting can end the benefit. Other actors do not automatically help, maintain the batch, transfer ownership or communicate observations.
Implementation reuse: record exact reuse of gather, navigate, learn, eat and applicable existing item-transfer/decay code in the development change record. Reuse compatible process reservation, interruption and observation components from controlled-food-processing-trial where available, recording which code is reused. This is a new moisture-dependent processing effect, not reinvention of those existing operations. Validate lifecycle and conservation in code; established rules must execute without recurrent model approval. Development and review waiting advance no simulation time, grant no inventory and confer no mastery.
